sources: Esri World_Imagery around the site points

values.note: 2026 and 2027: $28 a night. Two vehicles or one RV included; $11 for each additional vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231876/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06 and 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-05: 'PeakSTANDARD NONELECTRIC': 28; first-come seasons 2026 'Walk InSTANDARD NONELECTRIC': 28) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/kelsey-campground ('$28 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for each additional vehicle.'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231876 ('Drinking water is available from a hand pump, but hookups are not available') + catalog (every RV site STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 17 sites, 2 of them tent-only; back-in parking spurs up to 30 ft.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231876 ('Kelsey Campground has 17 single-family campsites'; 'Each site has a parking spur (up to 30 feet)') + catalog (15 STANDARD NONELECTRIC all Driveway Entry Back-In, 2 TENT ONLY; per-site Max Vehicle Length 20-60), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump; water, trash and the host may be missing in the spring and fall shoulder season. Firewood from the host. Poor cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/kelsey-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet'; Water 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.'; 'services such as water, trash or a host may not be available in the fall and spring') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231876 ('Firewood is also available to purchase from the camp host. Cell service is poor in the area.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: FS: open early May to late September, weather dependent; full service Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend. Dates are 2026's, from recreation.gov's first-come seasons.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/kelsey-campground ('This campground is open from early May to late September, dependent on weather'; Seasons of Use 'Early May to late September') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231876/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-21 and 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-19), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reserve at least four days ahead; walk-ups are exempt from the weekend and holiday minimums. Two sites are first-come, and the whole campground is first-come outside the reservation season (early May to Memorial Day, after Labor Day). Fees on site by cash, check or money order.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/kelsey-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231876 (rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4; notice 'Facility has first-come, first-served sites') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 05-22 to 09-06; First-come seasons either side) + catalog (sites 001 and 004 not reservable), read 2026-10-28

note: South Platte RD (Pike-San Isabel NF), in the Buffalo Creek Recreation Area on Jefferson County Road 126, 16.5 miles south of Pine Junction; ponderosa forest at about 8,000 ft, with the Kelsey Overlook just north. Bear closure order in place: store attractants hard-sided. --Claude
